description.content: Scrape a URL using a POST request with parameters in the request body. Useful for complex configurations or when URL length limits are a concern.

The Scrapfly Scrape API enables web scraping at scale with anti-bot bypass, proxy rotation, JavaScript rendering, and AI-powered data extraction. One API key unlocks access to web scraping, screenshot capture, structured data extraction, web crawling, and cloud browser automation.
